**Finding submitted — INDEMN: missing (critical).**

- **Investigation:** Read all five sections (p0001–p0072) plus targeted searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and IP-infringement language — no hits. Section 9 (Warranties) contains only corporate authority reps (a) and the Globix acknowledgement (b), and runs straight into Section 10 (General Provisions). There is no limitation-of-liability article, and Section 7.2's third-party IP reference is a mutual advertising covenant, not an indemnity. No one-way Company indemnity exists either, so nothing needed narrowing.
- **Target level:** preferred. Since the clause is genuinely absent, I inserted one new Section 9(c) after p0058 carrying only the ten preferred elements — HDI's defence/indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, HDI-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; notice, control and cooperation; and a Company indemnity confined to Company-provided Content and our breach of law.
- **Deliberate omissions:** no fallback 3× super-cap (it would only cap HDI in a contract with no liability cap), and no at-own-expense, survival or damages boilerplate.
